第67章 来自钱不缺的信（第1页）
入谷第六天，秦川收到了一封信。没有寄信人，没有信使。只是一天早晨他推开竹门，发现门缝下面塞着一个牛皮纸信封。信封上只写了三个字：秦川收。字体是端正的小楷，一丝不苟，墨迹还没干透。
秦川拆开信，里面只有一张纸。纸是上好的桑皮纸，薄而韧，折了三折。展开，上面只写了一句话——
“百草谷的账，我已经记下了。利息很高，让他们做好准备。”
当天下午，苏木槿来找他时，秦川把信给她看了。苏木槿看完，脸色微微变了。
“这个人的语气很熟——是你在青山村跟我提过的那个货郎？”
“嗯。他不只是货郎。他是诸天交易所的主人。”
苏木槿沉默了一会儿，将信还给秦川，手指微微发紧。“诸天交易所，我在古籍上读到过。那是一万多年前就已经存在的组织，不属于九尊，不属于上界，独立于所有势力之外。如果这个人说要记百草谷的账——”
“不用慌。他的账不是讨债的账，是投资的账。他记百草谷的账，说明他在关注百草谷对我的态度。如果百草谷对我好，这笔账就是善缘。如果百草谷对我不利，这笔账就会变成债务。”秦川将信折好，“暂时是护身符，不是催命符。”
苏木槿沉默了一会儿，点了点头。但她离开竹楼时脚步比平时快了几分——作为百草谷的圣女，她需要把这个消息告诉谷主。不是作为威胁，而是作为需要纳入考量的事实。
秦川坐在竹桌前，看着那张桑皮纸上的字迹，开始琢磨钱不缺真正的用意。这封信不是写给秦川的——钱不缺知道秦川不需要提醒。这封信是写给百草谷的。是让百草谷知道，这个凡人背后站着的人，比他们想象的要多。钱不缺在替秦川铺路——用他的方式。他是商人，商人的方式不是拔剑相助，而是在暗中写入一张秦川的价值被正式标注的账本。让所有可能对秦川不利的人知道：动他，就是动我的投资。
秦川收起信，将这件事记在心里。欠钱不缺的铜板债，越来越重了。但他不打算急着还——这笔债拖着，比还清更有用。

Chapter 67 Letter from Qian Buqiang (Page 1)
On the sixth day after entering the valley, Qin Chuan received a letter. There is no sender, no messenger. But one morning he pushed open the bamboo door and found a brown paper envelope stuffed under the door. There were only three words written on the envelope: Qin Chuan. The font is in regular regular script, meticulous, and the ink is not yet dry.
Qin Chuan opened the letter, and there was only a piece of paper inside. The paper is fine mulberry paper, thin and tough, folded in three. Expand it, there is only one sentence written on it——
"I have already taken note of Baicao Valley's account. The interest rate is very high, so let them be prepared."
That afternoon, when Su Mujin came to see him, Qin Chuan showed her the letter. After reading it, Su Muxin's face changed slightly.
"This man's tone is very familiar - is he the salesman you told me about in Qingshan Village?"
"Well. He is not just a salesman. He is the owner of the All-Heaven Exchange."
Su Mujin was silent for a while, then returned the letter to Qin Chuan, her fingers tightening slightly. "I have read about the Exchange of All Heavens in ancient books. It is an organization that has existed more than 10,000 years ago. It does not belong to the Nine Lords, does not belong to the upper world, and is independent of all forces. If this person says that he wants to keep the accounts of Baicao Valley - "
"Don't panic. His account is not a debt collection account, but an investment account. The fact that he kept Baicao Valley's account shows that he is paying attention to Baicao Valley's attitude towards me. If Baicao Valley is good to me, this account is a good karma. If Baicao Valley is not good for me, this account will become a debt." Qin Chuan folded the letter and said, "It is a talisman for the time being, not a talisman."
Su Muxin was silent for a while and nodded. But when she left the bamboo building, she walked a little faster than usual - as the saint of Baicao Valley, she needed to tell the valley owner the news. Not as a threat, but as a fact that needs to be taken into account.
Qin Chuan sat in front of the bamboo table, looked at the writing on the mulberry paper, and began to think about Qian Buqian's true intention. This letter was not written to Qin Chuan - Qian Buque knew that Qin Chuan did not need to be reminded. This letter is written to Baicao Valley. It was to let Baicao Valley know that there were more people standing behind this mortal than they imagined. Qian Buque is paving the way for Qin Chuan - in his own way. He is a businessman, and the way of a businessman is not to draw a sword to help, but to secretly write a ledger in which Qinchuan's value is officially marked. Let all those who may be unfavorable to Qin Chuan know: if you touch him, you will touch my investment.
Qin Chuan put away the letter and kept this matter in his heart. The copper debt, which is not lacking in money, is getting heavier and heavier. But he doesn't intend to rush to pay it off - this debt is more useful to drag on than to be paid off.
